name: Eliminator sound board
drawing: Sound board schematic in the Eliminator manual (doc cff008c00810) -- via MAME's netlist, compared with the sheets (800-3174 rev B sheets 7-8, pp65-68)
revision: Sega G-80 Eliminator sound board: background, skitter, two torpedo and explosion sounds, CA3080 VCAs. Zektor uses the same board; this is the Eliminator wiring.
coverage: Converted from MAME's netlist, which covers the sound circuits up to the final amplifier. See the .nets file for what was undone and what MAME leaves out.
